subject: sentences
title: Who, what, where, when
about: The six question words and what each one asks for: who wants a person, what a thing, where a place, when a time, why a reason, how a way or an amount. Question words sit in the Sentences row of NC's K-1 grammar continuum under L.1.1; this level builds on the question-word cards in Telling or asking? with new sentences and cards that match a question word to its kind of answer.
tip: After he picks the word, ask him to make up an answer, so he hears that where gets a place and when gets a time.

cards.sayQ: Blank is in the box? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: What asks about a thing. Some thing is in the box.

cards.sayQ: Blank did you put my hat? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Where asks about a place. The hat is in some place.

cards.sayQ: Blank made this cake? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Who asks about a person. A person made the cake.

cards.sayQ: Blank does the bus come? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: When asks about a time. The bus comes at a time.

cards.sayQ: Blank are you so happy? Which word fits the blank?
Blank do you tie a shoe? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: How asks the way to do something.

cards.q: ___ many legs does a dog have?
cards.sayQ: Blank many legs does a dog have? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: How many asks for a number. A dog has four legs.

cards.sayQ: Blank do you want for lunch? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: What asks about a thing. Lunch is a thing you can name.

cards.q: Someone asks who. What kind of answer do they want?
cards.note: Who asks about a person, like Mia or the mail carrier.

cards.q: Someone asks where. What kind of answer do they want?
cards.note: Where asks about a place, like the park or under the bed.

cards.q: Someone asks when. What kind of answer do they want?
cards.note: When asks about a time, like after lunch or on Monday.

cards.q: Someone asks why. What kind of answer do they want?
cards.note: Why asks for a reason. The answer often starts with because.

cards.q: The answer is Mia. Which question word was asked?
cards.note: Mia is a person, so the question was who. Who is at the door? Mia.

cards.q: The answer is in the park. Which question word was asked?
cards.note: The park is a place, so the question was where. Where is Ben? In the park.

cards.q: The answer is after lunch. Which question word was asked?
cards.note: After lunch is a time, so the question was when. When do we play? After lunch.

cards.q: The answer is a red ball. Which question word was asked?
cards.note: A red ball is a thing, so the question was what. What is in the bag? A red ball.
